maker.legs_note: This site only breaks the market-order total into step-by-step legs. The limit-order total above is a real, separately computed number, just not decomposed the same way.
maker.result_pct_meaning: The limit-order total cost of the whole transfer, in hundredths of a percent of the amount sent. Matches data/samples.csv row's own cost_bps_maker for this exact sample.

legs.legs_meaning: The market-order total, split into the five real steps money moves through: getting the sending currency onto the first exchange, buying the stablecoin, sending it on its own network, selling the stablecoin, and getting the receiving currency into a bank account. These five numbers add up to result_pct exactly, to the cent, by construction -- not approximately.

taker.result_pct_meaning: The market-order total cost of the whole transfer, in hundredths of a percent of the amount sent, every fee above already added in. Matches data/samples.csv row's own cost_bps_taker for this exact sample.

evidence.book_detail_meaning: The individual order book levels this calculation actually walked through are not saved -- only the prices and the amount filled that they produced. Full order book detail is a separate, later item.

offramp.average_price_received_meaning: The real average price received after selling through the order book at this amount, walking down from the best price.
offramp.slippage_bps_meaning: How much worse the average price received was than the best price on offer, in hundredths of a percent.
offramp.top_price_meaning: The best price on offer to sell the stablecoin when this hour's sample was taken.

onramp.average_price_paid_meaning: The real average price paid after buying through the order book at this amount, walking down from the best price.
onramp.slippage_bps_meaning: How much worse the average price paid was than the best price on offer, in hundredths of a percent.
onramp.top_price_meaning: The best price on offer to buy the stablecoin when this hour's sample was taken.

deposit.meaning: The bank fee for getting USD onto Coinbase has not been priced for this corridor yet.
deposit.value_bps_meaning: This leg's share of the total cost, in hundredths of a percent of the amount sent. Zero means either genuinely free or not priced -- see status.

network.value_stable_meaning: The fee actually paid to move the stablecoin itself on its own network, in units of the stablecoin, at this amount.

offramp.maker_bps_meaning: This exchange's fee for selling the stablecoin with a limit order.
offramp.taker_bps_meaning: This exchange's fee for selling the stablecoin with a market order.

onramp.maker_bps_meaning: This exchange's fee for buying the stablecoin with a limit order (set a price and wait for it to fill).
onramp.taker_bps_meaning: This exchange's fee for buying the stablecoin with a market order (take whatever price is on offer right now).

withdrawal.meaning: The bank fee for getting INR into a bank account has not been priced for this corridor yet.
withdrawal.value_bps_meaning: This leg's share of the total cost, in hundredths of a percent of the amount sent. Zero means either genuinely free or not priced -- see status.
